formats.title: Relationship Silhouettes + Truck
formats.description: Man and woman as pure black featureless silhouettes with a Ford F-150 at dusk in open country. Cinematic longing, golden-hour romance; the sky is the star. Captions burned on top.

formats.title: TruckTok UGC Walkaround

formats.title: Boat / Lake Ride POV
